title: Singing at wakes and the hymns bands played leaving the house
summary: Protestant wakes had all-night singing while Catholic ones were quiet. Bands played hymns like Nearer My God to Thee as the body left.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
